model.lookupLabel: STIHL Australia FS 240 (parts via STIHL dealer)
model.note: Part outlines are traced from STIHL's studio photo and are approximate. This view covers only the six FS 240 brushcutters; the other small tools in the small power equipment file (Kress and Husqvarna blowers, HSA 86, Honda pump, VPH70 compactor, robotic mower, Milwaukee blowers) are not in it. Only the fuel section of the STIHL FS 240 R manual was read: the rest is best practice and there are no part numbers yet. Get the FS 240 maintenance chart and parts list from a STIHL dealer.

engine.name: Engine and fan housing (2-stroke)
engine.desc: Two-stroke engine under the orange fan housing. Daily or weekly: clean the cylinder fins and air intake. Daily: no fuel leaks, fasteners tight. Stale or wrong-ratio fuel is the main cause of hard starting and seized pistons. Yearly (best practice): check the fuel lines and carburettor tune.

fuel.name: Fuel
fuel.desc: STIHL 50:1 two-stroke mix, minimum 89 octane (US manual figure), no more than 10% ethanol. Use fresh pre-mixed fuel only and one ratio across the fleet.

aircover.name: Air filter cover
aircover.desc: Cover over the air filter. Clean the air filter after each day or weekly; replace it yearly (best practice).

airfilter.name: Air filter
airfilter.desc: Daily: air filter clean. Clean after each day or weekly; replace yearly (best practice).

plug.name: Spark plug
plug.desc: Replace yearly (best practice). Plug type is not in the documents read: check the FS 240 manual.

muffler.name: Muffler and spark arrester screen
muffler.desc: Yearly (best practice): check the muffler and clean the spark arrester screen.

avmounts.name: Anti-vibration mounts
avmounts.desc: Yearly (best practice): check the anti-vibration mounts.

stopswitch.name: Stop switch
stopswitch.desc: Daily: the controls and stop switch work.

control.name: Control handle
control.desc: Right-hand control handle with the throttle trigger. Daily: controls and stop switch work.

grip.name: Left grip
grip.desc: Left-hand grip on the bike handle.

handlebar.name: Bike handle
handlebar.desc: Bike handle clamped to the drive tube. Daily: fasteners tight.

clamp.name: Handle clamp
clamp.desc: Clamp holding the bike handle on the drive tube. Daily: tight.

shaft.name: Drive tube
shaft.desc: Drive tube from the engine to the gear head.

gearbox.name: Gear head
gearbox.desc: Check the gearbox grease after each day or weekly and top up with STIHL gear grease as the manual says; grease it at the yearly service.

guard.name: Deflector guard
guard.desc: Daily: guard fitted and the right one for the cutting attachment and job.

head.name: Mowing head
head.desc: Line head. Check the cutting attachment and guard after each day or weekly. Replace cracked or bent cutting tools immediately.

line.name: Cutting line or blades
line.desc: Daily: cutting attachment right for the job. Replace cracked or bent cutting tools immediately.
